subject: Security questionnaire & retention pathfinder — action items and SLAs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novahealth.com>; procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Security questionnaire & retention pathfinder — action items and SLAs

Thanks for taking time today — quick recap and proposed next steps for the security/retention items we covered on the discovery call.

Key points from call:
- Scope: NovaHealth is evaluating Redwood for inference hosting for two product lines (clinical notes indexing + anonymized analytics).
- Compliance drivers: SOC 2, GDPR obligations for EU data, and HIPAA / BAA requirements for PHI.
- Retention ask: explicit clarification on log retention, backups, and deletion SLA for customer-requested erasures.
- Timeline: procurement would like vendor security questionnaire completed + BAA in place before pilot.

Action items I can own:
1) Share our vendor security questionnaire (attached) for you to mark up — vendor_security_questionnaire_NovaHealth.xlsx.
2) Provide a short retention matrix with default retention windows for logs and backups and proposed deletion SLA — retention_matrix_draft.csv attached.
3) Confirm SOC 2 status, BAA approach, and any HIPAA controls we have documented.

Preliminary answers from the call (to confirm internally):
- SOC 2: Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type II in progress; cert expected in Dec 2027 (Ben to confirm).
- Backups: snapshot cadence and retention differ by customer profile — default snapshots retained 30 days, logs 90 days (we should confirm with SE).
- Deletion SLA: propose 30 days from request for full removal from backups, with expedited options for PII (we'll propose 14-day SLA as a negotiable term).

Next steps / Requests from NovaHealth:
- Please flag any fields in the attached questionnaire you want us to populate first (infosec, procurement).
- Can you confirm who will own the questionnaire on your side? (Alice / Dinesh?)
- Would you like a focused session with our security engineering lead (Evelyn) to walk through logs/backups and the deletion flow?

Regards,

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_NovaHealth.xlsx, retention_matrix_draft.csv
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>; procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: Dinesh Singh <dinesh.singh@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 18:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire & retention pathfinder — action items and SLAs

Thanks Jonas — helpful summary. A couple of clarifying questions before we dive into the questionnaire:

1) SOC 2 timing: you mentioned December for Type II — can you confirm whether that will include the controls around change management and logging we discussed? We need visibility on the scope to scope our internal review.
2) For backups: when you say "snapshots retained 30 days," does that include cold backups and offsite replication? We need to know if backups may retain PII beyond our requested deletion window.
3) Deletion SLA: our security team prefers a shorter window (14 days) for removal of PII from all systems, including backups. Is that something Redwood can commit to (or provide an expedited path)?

We'll assign Dinesh to be the primary owner for the questionnaire — he'll coordinate with procurement for the contract/BAA. We prefer a walk-through with your security engineer before filling the questionnaire so we have answers for the tricky preservation/backups questions. Can you propose times for Wed/Thu?

Best,

Alice Jenkins
Director, InfoSec 
NovaHealth
alice.jenkins@novahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novahealth.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire & retention pathfinder — action items and SLAs

On Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 15:12, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking time today — quick recap and proposed next steps for the security/retention items we covered on the discovery call.

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick follow. A few concrete answers and proposed firm positions from Redwood so you have something to review internally: 

SOC 2:
- Status: Type II audit in progress; targeted completion: 2027-12-15.
- Coverage: includes the Security and Availability trust services categories. Change management and logging controls are in scope — we'll provide the SOC 2 bridge letter and the final report when available.

HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via a standard BAA addendum. We'll surface the BAA template (DocuSign link below) and can revise language for retention/deletion clauses if needed.

Retention / backups / deletion:
- Default logging retention: 90 days for request- and API-level logs.
- Snapshot / backup retention: default 30 days for automated snapshots. Offsite replication is retained according to the same policy unless a custom retention is requested.
- Customer deletion requests: our standard process removes live data within 24-72 hours; removal from backups and replication sets follows a scheduled purge — we propose a 30-day standard SLA for full removal.
- Expedited deletion: we can offer a 14-day expedited SLA for PII/PHI as a contractual option for pilot customers (subject to a limited fee or explicit clause).

Attachments: retention_policy_summary.pdf (short explainer), I'll also populate the questionnaire in the first pass and flag questions we need Evelyn to answer.

Proposed next steps:
1) Evelyn to run a 45-min technical deep-dive on backup architecture and log retention (Evelyn — are you available Thu 11/4 16:00 PT or Fri 11/5 10:00 PT?).
2) Jonas / Ben: populate the questionnaire and share a redline copy by EOD Thu 11/4.
3) We'll send a DocuSign for the BAA and a short addendum proposing the 14-day expedited deletion SLA for PII; procurement can decide on acceptance.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions & Security (Sales) | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: retention_policy_summary.pdf
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Dinesh Singh <dinesh.singh@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire & retention pathfinder — action items and SLAs

Thanks Ben — that helps a lot. We can proceed on the following basis: 

- Please share the SOC 2 bridge letter when available and the Type II report once completed. Change management/logging inclusion is important for our auditors.
- We accept a 30-day standard deletion SLA for non-PII items. For PII/PHI, NovaHealth requires a contractual 14-day deletion SLA from all copies, including backups/offsite replication. If Redwood can include an expedited 14-day PII deletion clause in the BAA/addendum, we can move forward with pilot approvals this week.
- Dinesh will own the questionnaire — he will expect a redlined, partially completed version from Redwood by EOD Thu 11/4.
- Scheduling: Thu 11/4 16:00 PT works for our team for a technical deep-dive with Evelyn.

Please send the DocuSign link for the BAA and the questionnaire redline; we'll have procurement start the internal review.

Regards,

Alice Jenkins
Director, InfoSec | NovaHealth
